card.title: China sends envoys to Eritrea and Ethiopia to help ease tensions
card.body: Special envoy Hu Changchun met Eritrea's President Isaias Afwerki in Asmara on Nov 5. Envoy Liu Xianfa is due in Ethiopia in early to mid-November.
